product_overview: VitalsSniper is a Chrome extension popup that helps users inspect Core Web Vitals, detect DOM and performance issues, and generate outreach scripts for pitching optimization services. It also supports saving leads, comparing competitors, configuring agency branding, and activating Pro features for cloud sync.
core_goals: Inspect a target website's Core Web Vitals and DOM diagnostics from the extension popup
Generate client outreach scripts in multiple channels and tones
Save prospects into a local lead pipeline and export them to CSV
Compare a target site against a competitor site side by side
Activate a Pro license or API key to enable cloud sync and premium access

features.name: Core Web Vitals and DOM Diagnostics
features.description: Lets the user inspect a target website or manual URL and review performance telemetry, DOM bloat, LCP breakdown, and related diagnostics in the popup.
user_flows: Navigate to /popup.html -> Enter a target URL -> Run a manual audit -> Review the health score and telemetry cards -> Inspect the 4-part LCP breakdown and DOM element counts

features.name: Outreach Script Generator
features.description: Generates outreach copy for different pitch channels and tones, with clipboard copy support.
user_flows: Navigate to /popup.html -> Switch to an outreach channel tab -> Choose a pitch tone -> Copy the generated script to the clipboard -> Paste the script into another app

features.name: Saved Lead Pipeline
features.description: Allows the user to save prospect sites locally, manage their stage, and export the pipeline as CSV.
user_flows: Navigate to /popup.html -> Save the current target as a lead -> Open the saved lead pipeline drawer -> Change the lead status -> Export the lead list as CSV
Navigate to /popup.html -> Open the saved lead pipeline drawer -> Delete a lead -> See the lead removed from the pipeline

features.name: Head-to-Head Competitor Comparison
features.description: Compares a target website against a competitor URL and shows win or loss metrics side by side.
user_flows: Navigate to /popup.html -> Open competitor comparison -> Enter a competitor website URL -> Run the head-to-head comparison -> Review the comparative metrics and win/loss breakdown

features.name: License Activation and Cloud Sync
features.description: Lets the user activate a Pro license voucher or WebAudits.pro API key and sync data to the cloud vault.
user_flows: Navigate to /popup.html -> Open the activation modal -> Enter a license key or API key -> Activate the license -> See the subscription status update
Navigate to /popup.html -> Open the activation modal -> Enter an invalid license key -> Attempt activation -> See the activation rejected message

features.name: Agency White-Label Branding Settings
features.description: Allows agencies to customize branding details such as agency name, auditor name, and website information.
user_flows: Navigate to /popup.html -> Open agency settings -> Enter the agency brand details -> Save the settings -> See the updated branding stored locally
